description: Create a subdomain that points at the VPS (free ZAP domain or one of the customer's domains). Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

domainId.description: Domain from get_vserver_dns `domains[].id`; default `platform` (the free ZAP domain).

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: create_vserver_subdomain
title: Create VPS Subdomain
